evidence.quote: For the key Authorization, enter the value Bearer {your_token}
If approved for API use, your app receives Trial access, which is best for exploring our API features.
If you want to offer Pinterest capabilities to your users, we recommend upgrading to Standard access to get the full functionality that our API offers.

result.notes: Pinterest API v5 is REST, OAuth 2.0 only (Authorization Code, Client Credentials, Refresh Token grants); token exchange uses HTTP Basic with client_id/client_secret, API calls use Bearer token. New apps must first be approved for free Trial access (sandbox-only Pins/Boards, business-day approval per community reports), then separately apply and wait 1-4 weeks with a demo video for Standard access to unlock full functionality/rate limits — this two-stage review gates real production use, hence admin_approval/app_review rather than self-serve. No official Pinterest-published MCP server found; only community MCP servers (e.g. cesteral/pinterest-mcp, getmcpads pinterest-ads) exist per registry hints.
result.one_liner: Pinterest is a visual discovery/social platform whose developer API (v5) lets apps manage boards, pins, ads, catalogs and user account data.
